family4PersonMatrix._note: Headline 'CHF 2,000+' total first-year value is supported by the 'maximum' scenario (CHF 2,074). Total includes direct bonuses, preferential prices, and realistic savings from selecting suitable products. Use qualifier 'depending on household eligibility and selected offers' on all public-facing claims. UBS banking is counted at the conservative CHF 40 (lowest/Easy-package) tier of the real CHF 40-150 refer-a-friend range; the previous UBS 3a/pension KeyClub line item was removed in Oct 2026 because that bonus does not exist (UBS confirms CHF 250 only for mortgage referrals, not pension/3a). IBKR is counted as a flat USD 200 (≈ CHF 192) per qualifying adult, corrected in Oct 2026 from an incorrect linear 'USD 1 per USD 100 deposited up to USD 1,000' model — the real program pays a flat USD 200 only once a USD 10,000 deposit has been held for 1 year, and is capped program-wide at the first 15 referrals (not guaranteed available). This correction significantly lowered the 'strong' and 'maximum' scenario totals and the headline claim from the previous CHF 3,500+ figure. Health insurance entries document realistic savings from suitable product selection (not a direct cash referral benefit). Review annually or when any provider terms change.
